faq.q: What is Dolls of Destruction in GTA 6?
faq.a: Dolls of Destruction is a character listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki. The wiki entry is the only record of it. Rockstar has not named it in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

faq.q: Is Dolls of Destruction confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Dolls of Destruction as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names it.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Dolls of Destruction?
faq.a: Most of it. Dolls of Destruction rests on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. How large the role is and whether the character is playable are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Dolls of Destruction be in the finished GTA 6?
faq.a: Not known. A wiki listing is a claim by a fan editor, not a Rockstar statement. Plenty of character entries written before a launch never appear in the game. This site records the claim and the source, and marks the entry unconfirmed until that changes.
